Senses.Explanation: How far apart do they stand. Xueyan Zuqin asks at the lantern festival how far his rain-lamp and cloud-moon scene sits from Yangshan's, answering himself that they are a different cart on the same track, Feiyin Tongrong caps an old winter-answer with his own frost-blowing verse and asks how far it stands from the ancient's, Meixi Fudu asks at his inauguration how today's hall stands against the general's erstwhile realm and calls it two fine shows in one contest, and Langye Huijue lifts his staff — one blow for the buddha's birth, one for turning the wheel, one for nirvana — and asks how far even those three deeds stand apart. Tian'an Sheng brandishes the staff that gives thirty blows to saint and commoner alike and asks how far that stands from Mazu, Yuan'an Liao slaps the cosmologist's calendar aside and asks how far this very moment stands from before heaven and earth split, Yinyuan Longqi weighs Huangbo's midnight banner against Śākyamuni's midnight star and calls for a judge with the dharma-selecting eye, Chushi Fanqi buries Yantou's own-chest flow as a deep pit and asks how far man and true man stand apart until the hearer climbs out, Yu'an Zhiji measures his decades of ox-herding against Nanquan's water-buffalo with 'thousand heads, ten-thousand heads — just know one head', and Miyun Yuanwu, after bread is offered at a Yunmen memorial meal, asks how far his own report stands from the old master's move.
